text:
marta (Finance): FYI I got an alert from the daily budget monitor showing PROD GPU pool ~42% over expected for June. Can someone confirm this is real or a metric issue?
ops-bot: Alert: daily-gpu-budget: PROD-gpu pool exceeded threshold. window=24h, over_by=42%. link: https://redwood/alerts/12345 :warning:
devon (Eng-Infra): Thanks, looking. Do we have tag drift between autoscale-created VMs and reserved pools?
sam (Eng-ML): I saw a spike in training jobs 6/18-6/19 that used transient nodes — but those should be tagged with team=research. Is the alert showing team=unknown?
marta (Finance): The alert summary shows tag:pool="prod-gpu" and team="" (empty). That seems suspicious — blank team should be rare.
izzy (PlatformOps): Can you paste the raw query that triggered the alert?
marta (Finance): Sure: ```SELECT DATE(day) as d, SUM(cost) as c FROM billing.gcp_costs WHERE pool="prod-gpu" AND DATE(day) BETWEEN '2024-06-01' AND '2024-06-20' GROUP BY d ORDER BY d```
devon (Eng-Infra): quick check: our autoscaler recently changed the instance template which removed metadata label `team` for preemptible instances. Possible label drift.
sam (Eng-ML): That would cause finance to attribute those costs to an unlabeled bucket. Does the billing pipeline prefer labels over labels in resource_manager?
izzy (PlatformOps): Yes, our attribution pipeline uses VM labels first, then falls back to project labels. If VM label `team` is missing, cost goes to "unlabeled". I can grep logs.
izzy (PlatformOps): running quick query: ```SELECT labels, COUNT(1) FROM billing.gcp_resources WHERE labels.pool='prod-gpu' AND DATE(_PARTITIONTIME) BETWEEN '2024-06-18' AND '2024-06-19' GROUP BY labels LIMIT 20```
izzy (PlatformOps): result: many entries with labels={"pool":"prod-gpu"} but no `team` key for ~380 instances.
marta (Finance): OK that explains the unlabeled cost spike. Rough ask: can we backfill team tags for cost attribution and suppress the alert?
devon (Eng-Infra): We rolled template v3.2 on 6/17 which accidentally omitted `labels.team`. I'll open infra PR to revert template and patch autoscaler.
sam (Eng-ML): Also will check whether any long-running jobs used those instances — if they did, we may need to charge teams accordingly.
izzy (PlatformOps): For backfill: we can map instances by creator project and job metadata. Steps: 1) identify affected instance IDs 2) map to job owner via internal registry 3) update billing labels in BQ using mapping table and re-run attribution job. I can start step 1 now.
marta (Finance): Please do the backfill and once attribution is updated, can we unmute the alert? We need accurate monthly numbers before close.
devon (Eng-Infra): PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/987 — revert template and add e2e check for required labels. ETA to merge and roll: today EOD.
izzy (PlatformOps): Quick adhoc patch to the billing pipeline to treat `project` fallback more intelligently and tag as `team=unknown-autoscale` instead of blank so alerts are less noisy. Will push a hotfix.
marta (Finance): That sounds good. Also can we get a cost estimate of the unlabeled bucket so I can update forecasts?
izzy (PlatformOps): Rough ballpark from the query: unlabeled prod-gpu cost for 6/18-6/19 = $18,400. I'll run a full June range and post a CSV.
sam (Eng-ML): If that $18.4k maps to research jobs, we should charge back to research. If it spreads across several teams, we may split proportionally by job owner runtime.
marta (Finance): Action items: 1) izzy — run full month attribution backfill and post results here (due: 6/21 10am). 2) devon — roll template fix + test (due: 6/21 EOD). 3) sam — confirm owners of long-running jobs (due: 6/21 noon). Finance will hold off on re-allocating budget until backfill completes.
izzy (PlatformOps): Started a job: `bq query --use_legacy_sql=false '...GROUP BY owner'` — will attach CSV when done.
marta (Finance): Thanks all. Reassigning the alert to ops and muting for 12h to avoid duplicate pages while you investigate :mute: 
ops-bot: Alert muted by marta (Finance) for 12 hours on channel #finance per incident policy.
devon (Eng-Infra): Noted. Will post patch and timeline in infra channel.
marta (Finance): I'll update leadership with a short note: "temporary label drift caused unlabeled GPU spend; backfill in progress; expected resolution 6/21".
izzy (PlatformOps): CSV uploaded: https://storage.redwood/finance/gpu-unlabeled-backfill-2024-06-20.csv — total unlabeled for June so far = $62,120, of which $18,400 is 6/18-6/19 spike.
marta (Finance): Perfect, thanks. We'll reconcile and update budgets after backfill. :white_check_mark:
